front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《43》

en: There is a place
The clear breeze and bright moon keep an appointment with me
Going to and from the Ode to the Red Cliffs

points.zh: 蓋將自其變者而觀之，則天地曾不能以一瞬，自其不變者而觀之，則物與我皆無盡也，而又何羨乎。且夫天地之間物各有主，苟非吾之所有，雖一毫而莫取。惟江上之淸風與山間之明月，耳得之而爲聲，目遇之而成色，取之無禁，用之不竭，是造物者之無盡藏也，而吾與子之所共適。        --宋 。蘇軾 《前赤壁賦》
points.en:
Viewed from the perspective of change, heaven and earth cannot remain still even for the blink of an eye; viewed from the perspective of the unchanging, all things and I alike are inexhaustible — so what is there to envy? Moreover, between heaven and earth, each thing has its own master; if it is not truly mine to possess, I shall not take so much as a hair of it. Only the cool breeze over the river and the bright moon between the hills — caught by the ear, they become sound; met by the eye, they become form. There is no prohibition on taking them, and no end to their use. These are the inexhaustible treasury of the Creator, and what you and I may enjoy together.
-- Song Dynasty. Su Shi, "Former Ode on the Red Cliff"

en: Morning fog, wandering through the woods
Listening to fallen leaves sigh
Autumn departs in silence
This journey, as if
Flower not flower, mist not mist
Walk, walk onward, and there will be a story

zh: 能使什麽永恆，像大理石
en: In truth, poetry may not even matter much
What can make something eternal, like marble
Rodin's sculpture: 'The Thinker'

points.zh: 「沉思者」（The Thinker），奧古斯特·羅丹 （ August Rodin, 1840-1917 ）的銅雕作品，目前存於法國巴黎的羅丹美術館。該雕像原本是群雕「地獄之門」橫楣上一座主雕像，也是該群雕的代表雕像之一，後來羅丹把它單獨製作出一座雕像，成了羅丹著名作品之一。

zh: 《沉思者》是羅丹《地獄門》上的重要作品之一，原名《 詩人》。關於作品中人物身分的認定，目前存有兩種說法。一派認為這位沉思者即是表現詩人但丁的形象。而另一種說法則是根據羅丹自己的說法，以及人物裸體的表現，認為《沉思者》是所有「詩人」與「創造者」的化身，思考著如何以詩文藝術創作來達到靈魂的解脫。不論是哪一種說法，羅丹省略五官細節，但強調光影和肌理刻劃的手法，精彩地營造出沉思者內心複雜的思緒。緊繃的筋肉，深刻的線條，内斂卻充滿張力的身軀，彷彿承擔著擔你我生命沉重的糾結，苦思人類不得其解的的難題。
en: "The Thinker" is one of the important works on Rodin's "The Gates of Hell," originally titled "The Poet." Regarding the identity of the figure in the work, two views currently exist. One school holds that this thinker represents the image of the poet Dante. The other, based on Rodin's own statements and on the nude rendering of the figure, holds that "The Thinker" is the embodiment of all "poets" and "creators," pondering how to achieve liberation of the soul through poetic and artistic creation. Whichever view one takes, Rodin omits detail in the facial features, yet through his emphasis on light, shadow, and the modeling of musculature, brilliantly conveys the complex inner thoughts of the thinker. The taut muscles, the deep-cut lines, the restrained yet tension-filled body seem to bear the heavy entanglements of your life and mine, agonizing over the unsolvable puzzles of humankind.
Fallen leaves, numbers adrift
The wind picks it up, calculating
Days when it snows

zh: 十萬光年長，比荷馬史詩
en: Imagining, wider than the diameter of the galaxy
A hundred thousand light-years long, longer than Homer's epic
Sixteen thousand lines, rich and abundant
Remembering the wind on the island that year
The island's song, by the lakeside
The moon like a hook
Mountain moon, pine wind, bamboo grove
Following the fisherman's song, walking into
Wang Wei's state of mind

points.zh:
晚年惟好靜，萬事不關心。
自顧無長策，空知返舊林。
松風吹解帶，山月照彈琴。
君問窮通理，漁歌入浦深。
--唐 。王維《酬張少府》
points.en:
In my later years I love only quiet; the affairs of the world no longer concern me.
Looking within, I have no great strategy; I know only to return to my old forest home.
The pine wind blows open my sash; the mountain moon shines as I play the qin.
You ask me the principle of success and failure — the fisherman's song drifts deep into the cove.
-- Tang dynasty. Wang Wei, 'In Reply to Assistant Magistrate Zhang'

en: The spring wind rises
A season of memory
There are tears, gentle as rain

zh: 告訴我，濱海小城的故事
en: Tell me the story of the small coastal town
After the rain, are the streetlamps still
The mood half-hidden beneath the umbrella?

points.zh:
《 港都夜雨 》
詞：吕傳梓   曲：楊三郎
今夜又是風雨微微  異鄉的都市
路燈青青  照著水滴  引阮心悲意
青春男兒不知自己  要行叨位去
啊～漂流萬里  港都夜雨寂寞暝
想起當時惦在船邊  講甲糖蜜甜
真正稀微你我情意  煞來拆分離
不知何時會再相見  前情斷半字
啊～海風野味  港都夜雨落抹離
《港都夜雨》，是臺灣戰後時期由呂傳梓作詞、楊三郎作曲，1958年發表的一首臺語流行歌曲，此曲原本是楊三郞譜的一首有曲無詞的旋律。1950年代初期，楊三郞在基隆接待駐臺美軍的「國際聯誼社」當樂隊指揮，同時也是小喇叭手。基隆天天下雨，1951年楊三郎在雨中突發靈感，使用自然小調以及和聲小調，以小喇叭吹奏出一淒婉的曲子，名為《雨的BLUES》，每天演奏，獲得美軍的喜愛，但一直沒有寫下歌詞，一日，樂隊中的琴手呂傳梓有感而發，以漂泊「港都」，四海為家的男兒觀覽夜雨時傷心的意象，寫下了歌詞，拿給《補破網》的作曲者王雲峰修飾，成了國際聯誼社的知名曲目。1958年楊三郞將此歌曲交給吳晉淮演唱，出版，隨後有基督教團體將之填上新詞，改編為聖歌。
--（取自維基百科）
